intent: Technical Brief: Asus TUF F15 System State Baseline
detected_fault: High gaming temperatures above 80°C with occasional spikes up to 90°C
suggested_solution: Monitor system temperatures during gaming and adjust settings accordingly
Disable Turbo Mode or use Throttlestop to reduce temperatures
Create a custom profile with optimized fan speeds, limited wattage, and PROCHOT settings
Regularly clean dust from the laptop's vents and fans
